summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing subsidiary agreements for data center construction ($40-50M), network equipment procurement ($10.1M), and a five-year technical service/maintenance contract ($1M) for an AI computing deployment in Indonesia. These are infrastructure agreements, not a special situation transaction. No stakeholder change, premium, or board recommendation exists. The filing discloses construction/supply risks and does not guarantee completion or revenue. As a routine operational expansion by a foreign private issuer, it is analogous to an ordinary current report on Form 8-K. This is not a special situation.
